digest.component_or_area: observability probe / marker emission in review_bot
propositions: Line-start marker strings (VOTER_ERROR, MERGE_CHANGE_ERROR, RECONCILE_DEGRADED, ARTIFACT_EMIT_ERROR, LLM_TOKEN_USAGE) are emitted twice: once via logger call and once via stderr print, causing anchored journald counts to double.

The root cause is configure_logging() attaching a StreamHandler to sys.stdout with %(message)s format, so logger.error/warning/info calls output the marker line-start prefix a second time that journald and observability.sh's grep anchor pick up.

The fix is to emit the marker line-start prefix ONLY via the unconditional print(line, file=sys.stderr) call, and change logger calls to log the structured record body without the token prefix, matching the existing _emit() pattern.
A structural class-guard test must prevent future markers from reintroducing the dual line-start-emission construct (token-prefixed string passed to both logger and stderr print).

The regression was introduced by commit b0ac2544720 (ticket c130-6a87-531e-4441) which wired configure_logging's stdout StreamHandler; the dual-emitter code predates it but did not cause visible doubling until the handler activated the second path.
